status: High-fidelity styled D1 visual studies for board-data; synthetic Storefront catalog, 5-state cells, console assistance, data-gravity activation and branch/DDL previews. Does not claim implemented browser routes or runtime performance.
notes: Generated in three pairwise reference chains sharing a single warm-daylight data studio specification inspired by DuckDB Local UI, MotherDuck Column Explorer and Databricks Unity Catalog Explorer. Final PNGs copied unchanged into docs/design/board-data/images/.

images.title: The unified Data Explorer, ERD canvas and SQL workbook
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a 16:9 high-fidelity desktop UI screenshot for Transit Board's data-first Explore workspace, inspired by DuckDB Local UI, MotherDuck Column Explorer and Databricks Unity Catalog Explorer. Warm daylight studio theme (#F8F7F4 canvas, #FFFFFF cards, #18181B typography, #0F766E teal selection, #D97706 amber histograms/keys, #4F46E5 indigo storage codec badges).
Top 56px header: Left has bold 'Transit' wordmark, compact Workspace/Operations icon toggle (Workspace grid active), and active 'Explore' tab. Center has 'Search Transit (⌘K)'. Right has realm pill 'Storefront' and branch/cut pill 'main · Manifest v42'.
Three-pane layout:
1. Left Catalog Navigator (220px): Scope 'Storefront · main (v42)'; TABLES (4): orders (selected, 1,420), shipments (1,180), inventory (320), supplier_ledger (640 · Foreign); MAINTAINED VIEWS (1): at_risk_deliveries (fresh · v42); DOCUMENTS (1): delivery_notes (84 rev); KV RESOURCES (1): carrier_quotes (512 keys).
2. Center Upper Half — Interactive ERD Canvas ('Schema ERD' selected beside 'Activation & Gravity' and 'Data Grid'): Four schema cards with orthogonal relationship lines: orders (Table · v12 · 1,420 rows, selected in teal, showing order_id INT64 [PK] [RLE], customer_id INT64 [BITPACK], warehouse_id INT64 [FK] [DICT], promised_day INT64, amount_cents INT64, region VARCHAR(32) [FSST · ASCII_CI]); shipments (Table · v9 · 1,180 rows, 1:N line to orders.order_id); inventory (Table · v7 · 320 rows, connected to orders.warehouse_id); at_risk_deliveries (Maintained View · v6, dashed dependency arrows from orders and shipments, badge 'Fresh · orders@v42, shipments@v38').
3. Center Lower Half — SQL Workbook Cell 1: Query 'SELECT o.order_id, o.warehouse_id, s.delay_hours FROM orders o INNER JOIN shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.delay_hours > 24;' with 3 result rows (1004 | 12 | 36, 1019 | 12 | 48, 1042 | 18 | 29) and timing bar 'Complete · 3 rows · Run 14 ms · Ready 28 ms · Cut: orders@v42, shipments@v38'.
4. Right Sidebar — Column Explorer (280px): 'Column Explorer · Result (3 rows, 3 cols)' with compact amber distribution bars, distinct/null counts and min/max for order_id (1004..1042), warehouse_id (12: 67%, 18: 33%), and delay_hours (29..48).

images.title: Console-powered SQL workbook, suffix-aware assistance and history search
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Using Image 3 as the visual system reference, show the multi-cell SQL Workbook in Transit Board demonstrating transit console's TLA+-modeled editor interaction state machine and catalog_v1 assistance:
Cell 1 (Completed Grouped Query): 'SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id;' with 3 result rows (12 | 1840, 18 | 920, 24 | 610) and provenance bar 'Complete coverage · 3 rows · Cut: inventory@v42 · Run 9 ms · Ready 19 ms'.
Cell 2 (Active Editing with catalog_v1 Suffix-Aware Autocomplete): User is typing 'SELECT o.order_id, s.|' above 'FROM orders o INNER JOIN shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id;'. At cursor s.|, an anchored catalog_v1 completion menu offers the exact INT64 columns of shipments: s."delay_hours" (selected in teal), s."eta_day", s."order_id", s."shipment_id", with footer 'catalog_v1 · Authorized basis: orders@v42, shipments@v38 · Tab/Enter to accept · Esc to dismiss'.
Cell 3 (Draft-Seeded Ctrl+R History Search & Authoritative Write Completion): Shows inline 'History search (Ctrl+R): UPDATE inventory SET reserved_qty =' with hint 'Esc restores original draft · Enter accepts into draft (Undoable)', and below it a command completion receipt banner: 'Statement completed · Outcome: applied · Matched: 1 · Changed: 1 · Operation #op-9042 · Catalog revision v43'.

- Card B: 'DROP TABLE inventory RESTRICT;' -> Coral/Amber badge 'Rejected by RESTRICT · Blocked by 2 registered dependents: view warehouse_coverage, query Q4' with mini dependency diagram.

- Right ('branch/reallocate-inventory · Scenario v42+3'): '5 orders at risk (−9) · Max delay: 18 hrs (−30 hrs) · Exposure: $11,200' with badge 'Scenario branch result · Production main unchanged'.
